title: What does he look like?
summary: Describe what people look like (face, hair, eyes, glasses, beard) with adjectives that agree.
intro: To ask what someone looks like, say كَيْفَ شَكْلُهُ؟ (literally 'how is his shape?'), or كَيْفَ شَكْلُهَا؟ for a woman. Adjectives agree with their noun in gender and in 'the'. A noun with a possessive ending counts as definite, so 'his long hair' is شَعْرُهُ الطَّوِيل, while شَعْرُهُ طَوِيل is a sentence: his hair is long.
objectives: Ask what someone looks like with كَيْفَ شَكْلُهُ؟
Describe hair, eyes and face with at least three adjectives
Make an adjective agree in gender and definiteness
Say who someone looks like with يُشْبِهُ

realLife.title: Lunch at Sami's
realLife.story: On Friday Daniel has lunch with Sami's family. After the meal Sami's mother, Dr Fatima, asks about his family in Chicago. Daniel shows her photos on his phone and does his best to describe his father, his mother and Emma in Arabic.

sentences.en: What does your sister look like?
Her hair is blond and long.

mistakes.why: The adjective agrees with شَعْر, which is masculine, not with 'her'.

sentences.ar: أَبِي رَجُل طَوِيل، وَعِنْدَهُ لِحْيَة صَغِيرَة.
sentences.en: My father is a tall man, and he has a small beard.
sentences.literal: my father (is) a man tall, and at him (is) a beard small

mistakes.why: The father is the object of the verb, so أَب + his takes the object form أَبَاهُ.

sentences.en: My little sister is very pretty.
sentences.literal: my sister the little (is) pretty very

dialogue.title: Photos from Chicago
dialogue.culture: Older people often call a young guest يَا ابْنِي (my son) or يَا بِنْتِي (my daughter). It is a warm, friendly way to speak, not a sign of a real family tie. The hostess's بِالْهَنَاء وَالشِّفَاء means 'with joy and good health', in other words 'enjoy it, you're welcome'.

lines.ar: أَهْلًا يَا دَانْيَال، بَيْتُنَا بَيْتُكَ! حَدِّثْنِي عَنْ عَائِلَتِكَ فِي شِيكَاغُو. هَلْ عِنْدَكَ صُوَر؟
lines.en: Welcome, Daniel, our home is your home! Tell me about your family in Chicago. Do you have any photos?

lines.ar: شُكْرًا يَا دُكْتُورَة! نَعَم، الصُّوَر فِي هَاتِفِي. هٰذَا أَبِي، اسْمُهُ مَايْكِل.
lines.en: Thank you, doctor! Yes, the photos are on my phone. This is my father; his name is Michael.

lines.ar: مَا شَاءَ اللّٰه! أَبُوكَ رَجُل طَوِيل. وَأَنْتَ تُشْبِهُ أَبَاكَ كَثِيرًا يَا دَانْيَال.
lines.en: How lovely! Your father is a tall man. And you look a lot like your father, Daniel.

lines.ar: صَحِيح، الْكُلّ يَقُولُ ذٰلِكَ! لَهُ شَعْر بُنِّيّ قَصِير، وَعِنْدَهُ لِحْيَة صَغِيرَة.
lines.en: That's true, everyone says so! He has short brown hair, and he has a small beard.

lines.ar: وَمَنْ هٰذِهِ السَّيِّدَة الَّتِي تَلْبَسُ نَظَّارَة؟ هَلْ هِيَ أُمُّكَ؟ وَجْهُهَا لَطِيف جِدًّا.
lines.en: And who is this lady wearing glasses? Is she your mother? She has a very kind face.

lines.ar: نَعَم، هٰذِهِ أُمِّي. هِيَ قَصِيرَة قَلِيلًا، وَشَعْرُهَا أَسْوَد، وَعُيُونُهَا خَضْرَاء.
lines.en: Yes, this is my mother. She is a little short, her hair is black and her eyes are green.

lines.ar: وَمَنْ هٰذِهِ الْبِنْت الْجَمِيلَة؟ شَعْرُهَا الطَّوِيل أَشْقَر مِثْلَ الذَّهَب!
lines.en: And who is this pretty girl? Her long hair is as blond as gold!

lines.ar: هٰذِهِ أُخْتِي إِيمَا. هِيَ طَالِبَة فِي الْجَامِعَة، وَتَدْرُسُ الْعَرَبِيَّة مِثْلِي!
lines.en: This is my sister Emma. She is a student at university, and she studies Arabic like me!

lines.ar: أُخْتُكَ لَا تُشْبِهُكَ أَبَدًا! شَعْرُكَ بُنِّيّ وَقَصِير، وَشَعْرُهَا أَشْقَر وَطَوِيل.
lines.en: Your sister doesn't look like you at all! Your hair is brown and short, and hers is blond and long.

lines.ar: صَحِيح، إِيمَا تُشْبِهُ أُمِّي فِي الْوَجْه، وَأَنَا أُشْبِهُ أَبِي.
lines.en: That's right: Emma looks like my mother in the face, and I look like my father.

lines.ar: وَأَنْتَ يَا سَامِي تُشْبِهُ أَبَاكَ أَيْضًا: نَفْسُ الْوَجْه وَنَفْسُ الْعُيُون!
lines.en: And you, Sami, look like your father too: the same face and the same eyes!

lines.ar: نَعَم يَا أُمِّي، لٰكِنَّ أَبِي عِنْدَهُ نَظَّارَة، وَأَنَا لَا!
lines.en: Yes, Mum, but my father has glasses, and I don't!

lines.ar: أَنْتُمْ عَائِلَة جَمِيلَة جِدًّا. شُكْرًا عَلَى الْغَدَاء اللَّذِيذ يَا دُكْتُورَة فَاطِمَة!
lines.en: You are a lovely family. Thank you for the delicious lunch, Dr Fatima!

lines.ar: بِالْهَنَاء وَالشِّفَاء يَا ابْنِي! تَعَالَ إِلَيْنَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ جُمُعَة.
lines.en: You're very welcome, my son! Come and see us every Friday.

reading.title: Emma
reading.ar: إِيمَا أُخْتُ دَانْيَال. هِيَ طَالِبَة فِي شِيكَاغُو. شَعْرُهَا أَشْقَر وَطَوِيل، وَوَجْهُهَا جَمِيل. هِيَ تُشْبِهُ أُمَّهَا، وَدَانْيَال يُشْبِهُ أَبَاهُ.
reading.en: Emma is Daniel's sister. She is a student in Chicago. Her hair is blond and long, and she has a pretty face. She looks like her mother, and Daniel looks like his father.

quiz.prompt: How do you ask 'What does he look like?'
Choose the correct sentence: 'Her hair is long.'
Which of these letters is NOT emphatic?

completion: Wonderful! You can describe what people look like and make your adjectives agree.
